d.ko:
Echo of Starsong is a visual novel style adventure game.
Eda, a girl who can hear mysterious sound waves known as starsong, crosses paths with a young man in search of their source. Together, they venture out to the heart of space to unravel an ancient myth.

d.zh: 这是一个结合太空探索与冒险解谜的叙事游戏。未知的小行星“龙脉”由于其矿藏蕴藏的巨大能量，成为众人争夺的目标，能唱出龙脉之歌的少女——艾妲，将与立志探索龙脉的少年一同冒险，揭露宇宙的远古神话。
